title: 第4章  我给你揉揉
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦京茹是真饿急眼了，一口气往肚子里塞了八个窝头。

再加俩煎蛋，一碗油汪汪的蛋花汤灌下去，想不撑着都难。

“哎哟，撑死我了！”撂下碗筷，她趴在桌上直哼哼，动都不想动一下。

李阳白了她一眼，没好气地说：

“刚才就跟你说悠着点吃，你偏不听，这下自个儿遭罪了吧？”

秦京茹没话可说，噘着嘴，眉头皱成一团，可怜巴巴地拿眼瞅着李阳。

“要不要我给你揉揉？”李阳见她实在难受，心又软了。

这人要是一顿吃太撑了，食儿全堵在胃里头下不去。

用掌心顺着肚皮往一个方向慢慢揉，能帮着活络活络肠胃。

不过揉的时候手得轻，不能使大劲，才能有点儿助消化的意思。

秦京茹愣了愣，问：“咋揉？”

李阳笑着把法子说了一遍。

秦京茹听完，脸腾地红了，耳朵根子都烧起来了。

她咬了咬嘴唇，犹豫了那么一小会儿，低下头，声音跟蚊子哼哼似的：

“那你就帮我揉揉吧。你帮我揉，我心里头不膈应。”

李阳笑了一下，没再多说。

起身倒了盆热水，把手仔细搓洗干净，搬了把凳子坐到秦京茹旁边。

一股子说不上来的香气飘过来，秦京茹只闻了一下，嗓子眼就发干。

再偷眼瞅瞅李阳那张棱角分明的脸，她心里头忽地就软成了一滩水。

眼睛里水汪汪的，蒙着一层薄薄的雾。

李阳见秦京茹脸蛋红扑扑的，羞得眼都不知道往哪儿放。

心里暗暗好笑，便一只手扶着她肩膀，一只手搁在她肚子上。

秦京茹下意识按住了李阳的手，又揪了揪棉袄下摆，顿了顿，又松开了。

突然，她浑身一紧，脑子里嗡嗡的，头皮都酥了，嘴里磕磕巴巴地说：

“李阳哥，这么揉真管事？”

“管不管事，你等会儿就知道了。”李阳轻声细语地回了一句。

心里头却暗暗纳罕，这秦京茹也不晓得是咋长的，腰上愣是掐不出半点赘肉来。

李阳有中医那套传承的底子，手上功夫自不必说，立时就有了效验，秦京茹很快就觉出舒坦来了。

只是这功夫她整个人已经软得跟面条似的。

歪在李阳怀里，安安静静地不想吱声。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Jingru was so hungry that she stuffed eight steamed buns into her stomach in one breath.

Add two fried eggs and a bowl of oily egg drop soup, and it's hard not to hold it down.

"Ouch, you're killing me!" She put down her dishes and chopsticks and lay on the table, groaning, not even wanting to move.

Li Yang rolled his eyes at her and said angrily:

"I just told you to take your time and eat, but you didn't listen. Are you going to suffer now?"

Qin Jingru had nothing to say, she pursed her lips, frowned, and looked at Li Yang pitifully.

"Would you like me to rub it for you?" Seeing that she was really uncomfortable, Li Yang felt soft again.

If this person eats too much, all the food will be stuck in his stomach and he will not be able to get it down.

Use your palms to slowly rub your belly in one direction, which can help activate your intestines and stomach.

But when kneading, you have to be gentle and don't use too much force, so that it can help digestion.

Qin Jingru was stunned and asked, "How to rub it?"

Li Yang smiled and explained the method again.

After hearing this, Qin Jingru's face turned red and her ears were on fire.

She bit her lip, hesitated for a moment, lowered her head, and said in a voice like a mosquito:

"Then you can rub it for me. If you rub it for me, I won't feel sick."

Li Yang smiled and said nothing more.

He stood up and poured a basin of hot water, washed his hands carefully, moved a stool and sat next to Qin Jingru.

An indescribable aroma wafted over, and Qin Jingru's throat felt dry after just one whiff.

Taking another furtive look at Li Yang's angular face, her heart suddenly softened into a puddle of water.

His eyes were watery and covered with a thin layer of fog.

Li Yang saw Qin Jingru's face flushed and was so embarrassed that he didn't know where to look.

Feeling secretly amused, he put one hand on her shoulders and the other on her belly.

Qin Jingru subconsciously held down Li Yang's hand, then tugged at the hem of the cotton-padded jacket, paused, and then let go.

Suddenly, her whole body tensed up, her head was buzzing, her scalp felt numb, and she stammered:

"Brother Li Yang, are you really in charge of rubbing like this?"

"Don't worry about it, you'll find out later." Li Yang replied softly.

But she was secretly wondering how Qin Jingru grew, and she couldn't find any fat on her waist.

Li Yang has the foundation of traditional Chinese medicine, and not to mention his skill, it was effective immediately, and Qin Jingru soon felt comfortable.

But at this moment, her whole body was as soft as noodles.

Lying in Li Yang's arms, he quietly didn't want to say anything.
